real_gap_found.statement: writeDelegatedResponsibilityOutcomeDocument() (services/genieDelegatedResponsibilityOutcomeCapture.mjs) always writes a new, millisecond-timestamped file with no existence/content check, and its only caller (scripts/verify-genie-delegated-responsibility-outcome-capture-v1.mjs) always performed both real checks and both writes unconditionally, with no prior check of assessPhaseCapture(). Because assessPhaseCapture()'s CAPTURED rule (services/genieOjtCaptureEnforcement.mjs) only ever depends on the canonical Experience's fixed evidence.evidence_source file still being present -- never on how many other documents exist for that phase -- every write after the very first one on 2026-09-01T06:55Z-ish was provably inert.
real_gap_found.audit_method: Cross-referenced all project-brain-genie-{regression,production-runtime}-responsibility-v1-outcome-*.json files in this directory (93 total, 2026-09-01T06:54Z..2026-09-02T12:39Z) against every evidence_source string in every project-brain-experience-*.json file. Exactly 2 of the 93 (the earliest of each family) are referenced by any canonical Experience; the other 91 are byte-identical to their family's original except generated_at and are referenced nowhere.

fix.method: Before each of the two real-execution blocks, call the existing, unmodified assessPhaseCapture(readCaptureState(root), completion). If status is already CAPTURED, skip the real check (drift monitor / operational report compile / 19-script regression spawn) and the write entirely, and instead call a small local reverifyCapturedEvidence() helper that re-reads the canonical Experience's evidence.evidence_source path and asserts the file still exists on disk. Only run the real check and write a new document when the phase is not yet CAPTURED.
